$format.about: One entry per system type, from the Master Template: the SHAPE of a block only (header form, line order, wording form per slot, tech-hour rule). Never content: no default lines, no device a block gets without this job's evidence. Read by src/bms/playbook.py, which rejects a malformed file.
$format.shapes: A list of shape entries. Names are unique.

entry.name: The shape name (System.shape refers to it), e.g. "Exhaust Fan".

applies_to.prefixes: Tag prefixes that pick this shape (upper case, no dash), e.g. ["EF", "GEF"].
applies_to.kind_words: Words in a family or system name that pick this shape when no prefix does, lower case, e.g. ["exhaust fan"].

entry.header: The block header form. Placeholders: {n} the printed count (or ## when unknown), {name} the system name, {tags} the tags as printed (a range when consecutive).
entry.family_names: The family names this shape's blocks carry, in print order (a VRF block: indoor, condensing, branch selector).
entry.line_order: Every slot name, in print order. A device's slot must be one of these.
entry.slot_kinds: Per slot: "device" (hardware AME or another party furnishes), "point" (a control point / signal on equipment), "interlock" (a tie to another system, no verb), "integration" (the integration trio's lines), "wiring" (wiring only). Every slot in line_order has a kind.
entry.wording: Per slot: the house phrase form. Placeholders: {verb} the device's verb, {device} the device's name in the document's words, {owner} the owner bracket from wording.json (empty when AME furnishes), {qty} the quantity form from wording.json (empty when the block count applies), {what} the equipment named in an integration line. Every slot in line_order has a wording.

tech_hours.per: What the hours count per: one of unit, hardware_point, indoor_unit, panel, fan, fixed, line.
tech_hours.hours: Hours per item, or null when the rule gives none unless a condition below holds.
tech_hours.when: A list of {"if": [slot names], "hours": number}: these hours apply when the block has a device in every slot named.
